plain.li: Let's give {OTHER_nameDef} a proper grave.
Somewhere quiet, near home.
Bring a shovel, please.
[winter] The ground's hard, but it can be dug.

blunt.li: Not the butcher's table, not for {OTHER_nameDef}.

cheerful.li: Let's find {OTHER_nameDef} a spot in the sun.

gloomy.li: I knew this day would come.

cold.li: A grave first, then everything else.

plain.li: Deep enough that nothing digs it up.
Gently now.
This spot gets the morning sun.

cheerful.li: You'd have dug this faster than me, {OTHER_nameDef}.

plain.li: We buried {OTHER_nameDef} today, near home, deep enough to keep the body safe.
{OTHER_nameDef} is in the ground now. I didn't think a grave could take so long, or be over so fast.
[winter] The ground was hard as iron. {OTHER_nameDef} got a grave anyway.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has a grave now, a quiet one. I said goodbye before it was filled in.

gloomy.li: A hole in the ground and a good animal in it. That was the whole day.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is buried properly. It was the right thing to do.

plain.li: We meant to bury {OTHER_nameDef} today. It didn't happen, and the body is still lying there.

blunt.li: Nobody buried {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll do it myself if I have to.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still out there. I keep looking at the spot.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} lies in a grave near the colony now, where {PAWN_nameDef} can find it.
[small] It's a small grave, and {PAWN_nameDef} says it's the right size for {PET_nameDef}.
[big] {PET_nameDef} needed a big grave, and {PAWN_nameDef} says it was worth the work.
[winter] {PET_nameDef}'s grave was dug in frozen ground, and {PAWN_nameDef} says that's the least {PET_nameDef} deserved.
[bonded] {PAWN_nameDef} says {PET_nameDef} is home for good now.

warm.li: {PAWN_nameDef} thanked everyone who helped bury {PET_nameDef}, one at a time.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef} is buried. {PAWN_nameDef} didn't want to talk about it, and nobody made {PAWN_objective}.

cheerful.li: {PAWN_nameDef} says {PET_nameDef} would have liked the spot, and that's what matters.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} says {PET_nameDef}'s grave is the one good thing to come out of a bad week.

cold.li: {PAWN_nameDef} wrote the day of {PET_nameDef}'s burial in the ledger, under the day it died.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} is in the ground now, near home. I know where to go when I miss it.
[small] Such a small grave. It looked smaller still once it was filled in.
[big] It took a long time to make a grave big enough for {PET_nameDef}. Worth every minute.

warm.li: I said goodbye properly this time. {PET_nameDef} was a good animal, the best.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef}'s buried. That's all I want to write.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} would have hated sitting still in a grave. I hope it's chasing something, wherever it is.

gloomy.li: At least nobody will butcher {PET_nameDef} now. That's what I keep telling myself.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef}: buried. The body won't draw scavengers now.

plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} shared a quiet word over their cups.
{PAWN_nameDef} sat down with a cup beside {OTHER_nameDef}, and they talked about the day ahead.
[morning] {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} warmed their hands on their morning cups and talked about nothing much.
[evening] {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} finished their cups together and talked over the day.

warm.li: {PAWN_nameDef} asked {OTHER_nameDef} how {OTHER_pronoun} had slept, and listened to the whole answer over the cups.

blunt.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} drank their cups side by side and said what needed saying, which wasn't much.

cheerful.li: {PAWN_nameDef} raised a cup to {OTHER_nameDef}, and the two of them laughed about something nobody else heard.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} agreed over their cups that this was the best part of the day.

cold.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} compared notes on the day's work over their cups.
